author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0045149 acetoin metabolic process
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32260

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed (direct, plus annotations that use GO:0045149 in an extension):

| Gene | GO term | Evidence | Reference | Extension | Assigned by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| YPR1 (SGD:S000002776) | GO:0045149 acetoin metabolic process | IDA | PMID:33845171 | | SGD |
| ARA1 (SGD:S000000353) | GO:0045149 acetoin metabolic process | IDA | PMID:33845171 | | SGD |
| ORA1 (SGD:S000004839) | GO:0045149 acetoin metabolic process | IDA | PMID:33845171 | | SGD |
| YPR1 (SGD:S000002776) | GO:0052588 diacetyl reductase ((S)-acetoin forming) (NAD+) activity | IDA | PMID:33845171 | part_of(GO:0045149) | SGD |
| ARA1 (SGD:S000000353) | GO:0052588 diacetyl reductase ((S)-acetoin forming) (NAD+) activity | IDA | PMID:33845171 | part_of(GO:0045149) | SGD |
| ORA1 (SGD:S000004839) | GO:0052588 diacetyl reductase ((S)-acetoin forming) (NAD+) activity | IDA | PMID:33845171 | part_of(GO:0045149) | SGD |

Notes for review (from the abstract of PMID:33845171; full text to be checked). In an engineered (R)-acetoin-producing *S. cerevisiae* strain:
- Ara1 and Ypr1 reduce (R)-acetoin to meso-2,3-butanediol in vitro and contribute to meso-BDO production in vivo. Possible BP replacement: GO:0034079 butanediol biosynthetic process (IMP), if supported.
- Ora1 does not contribute to meso-BDO in vivo; it reduces (S)-α-acetolactate to 2,3-dimethylglycerate. Likely BP removal, and the extension dropped.
- MF check: the activity in the abstract is (R)-acetoin → meso-2,3-butanediol, not diacetyl → (S)-acetoin (GO:0052588), and the cofactor may be NADPH rather than NAD. Confirm GO:0052588 against the full text, or move to the correct MF (a new term may be needed).

Impacted groups: 
SGD 6 (3 direct + 3 extensions): @edwong57

Annotations can be viewed here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1qJXzTmOJ-YF1b5M-XHdKsVna2e0Fl5IOroPPt5YbC4w/edit?usp=sharing

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
- InterPro2GO: IPR003085 (Acetoin utilization protein AcuC) → GO:0045149. Suggest remapping to GO:0045150 acetoin catabolic process, consistent with IPR024699 (AcuA) → GO:0045150.

For reference, the other direct experimental annotation in this branch is not affected: *B. subtilis* acuA (UniProtKB:P39065) GO:0045150 acetoin catabolic process, IGI, PMID:7934817 (UniProt). GO:0045150 is being kept.

Thanks.
